nodes.label: Development Workflow
nodes.rationale: Never deploy until told — push only when asked; CI + Vercel deploy automatically on merge to main. pnpm build runs Vite only and does not typecheck, so tsc --noEmit must always be run separately before pushing.

nodes.label: No Supabase SDK Architecture Decision
nodes.rationale: @supabase/supabase-js is not a dependency; every auth flow (email/password, Google/Facebook OAuth, logout) goes through Aurevo.BE's /api/auth/* endpoints, and tokens live in localStorage rather than a Supabase session. VITE_SUPABASE_URL is optional and only used to build storage image-transform URLs.

nodes.label: Auth State Reactivity (useMeQuery)
nodes.rationale: useMeQuery's queryFn checks for a token itself and returns null if absent rather than using enabled: !!token, because enabled is captured once at render time; a token stored after render would leave the query permanently disabled until a remount.

nodes.label: Radix Select Empty-String onValueChange Guard
nodes.rationale: Radix Select fires an empty-string onValueChange on mount when its value is set programmatically; the checkout upazila picker and dashboard address-edit dialog guard with 'if (!value) return;' and render current value as a plain span instead of SelectValue to avoid the autofilled value being wiped or a placeholder flashing.

nodes.label: messenger-chat.tsx Removal
nodes.rationale: The AI chat widget replaced the old floating Facebook Messenger deep-link chat button (messenger-chat.tsx, removed); the static footer Messenger icon link is unrelated and still present.

nodes.label: cartLimiter Rate Limit Interaction
nodes.rationale: POST /cart/items shares infrastructure with the login rate limiter's neighbor cartLimiter (BE-side); running the e2e suite many times in quick succession can exhaust the limiter, causing 'Add to Cart' to silently do nothing until the BE dev server is restarted.

nodes.label: Saved Address Default Toggle Layout Guard
nodes.rationale: The saved-addresses 'Set as default' control is always rendered (hidden with invisible, not conditionally unmounted) specifically so toggling default doesn't change a card's height and jump the grid.
nodes.norm_label: saved address default toggle layout guard

nodes.label: Cart Two Stock Sources
nodes.rationale: product_variants.stock/reserved_stock is what cart, availability checks, and checkout read; inventory.quantity is what the Inventory admin page reads. These are different ledgers, kept in sync atomically by upsertInventory.

nodes.label: Backend-only Auth (Supabase SDK Removed)
nodes.rationale: @supabase/supabase-js was removed from the frontend; email/password and OAuth all go through Aurevo.BE. VITE_SUPABASE_URL + VITE_USE_SUPABASE_IMAGE_TRANSFORM still exist only for storage image-transform URL rewriting, not auth.

nodes.label: Footer Mobile Layout
nodes.rationale: Category and About Shop render side by side on mobile (grid-cols-2 + sm:contents); Fast Delivery link removed from About Shop.
